S1_WITHIN_ONE_PLAYER_CARD_RESOLUTION:O1_.reason: Authored card effects are ordered arrays with existing multi-subeffect traces, resolved in array order.

S1_WITHIN_ONE_PLAYER_CARD_RESOLUTION:O2_.reason: The card resolver dispatches each existing element of an authored multi-subeffect array independently.

S1_WITHIN_ONE_PLAYER_CARD_RESOLUTION:O3_.reason: A card effect has an existing repetition count and the resolver executes that primitive effect in its repetition loop.

S1_WITHIN_ONE_PLAYER_CARD_RESOLUTION:O4_.reason: An authored chip subeffect is settled in the post-effects card-resolution loop.

S1_WITHIN_ONE_PLAYER_CARD_RESOLUTION:O5_.reason: A card status subeffect carries its own target field, and the resolver has target, self, and all-enemy status routes.

S1_WITHIN_ONE_PLAYER_CARD_RESOLUTION:O6_.reason: The per-effect kind dispatcher has distinct existing combat-result branches within one card resolution.

S1_WITHIN_ONE_PLAYER_CARD_RESOLUTION:O7_.reason: The existing leech primitive captures realised enemy loss and guards its following heal on that result.

S4_WITHIN_ONE_ENEMY_ACTION_RESOLUTION:O1.reason: Existing enemy moves contain compound primitive fields and the action resolver dispatches their ordered subeffects.

S4_WITHIN_ONE_ENEMY_ACTION_RESOLUTION:O2.reason: Existing compound enemy moves expose independently dispatched primitive fields.

S4_WITHIN_ONE_ENEMY_ACTION_RESOLUTION:O3.reason: An authored enemy damage primitive has an existing repetition count and is executed in the action repetition loop.

S4_WITHIN_ONE_ENEMY_ACTION_RESOLUTION:O4.reason: The enemy move’s final authored subeffect slot precedes an explicit enemy end-of-action settlement boundary.

S4_WITHIN_ONE_ENEMY_ACTION_RESOLUTION:O5.reason: An enemy fx subeffect carries an existing recipient and the action resolver routes player, self, and ally recipients.

S4_WITHIN_ONE_ENEMY_ACTION_RESOLUTION:O6.reason: Existing enemy moves contain distinct result fields and the resolver has separate existing result handlers.

S4_WITHIN_ONE_ENEMY_ACTION_RESOLUTION:O7.reason: Enemy damage returns realised loss and the same action has a later fx subeffect dispatch slot.
